result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_node()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get a node object by ID or label. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L4437-L4484){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_node(node) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Get node](/assets/graphs/get-node.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="The shared four-node graph with node ids in pills. Node B, the query, is outlined in the accent color with its id 2 highlighted. The card returns the Node object Node(id=2, label='B')." width="100%"} Retrieves the `Node` object for the specified node. The `Node` object contains `id`, `label`, and attributes properties. Returns `None` if node doesn't exist. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Node ID (str) or internal ID (int) to retrieve. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Node | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `Node` object or `None` if not found. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} `get_node()` accepts either a label or an internal ID, and returns the underlying `Node` object with its `id`, `label`, and `attributes`: ::: {#4c3b87d4 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph().add_node(label="A", color="red", size=10) node = graph.get_node("A") node.id ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1 ``` ::: ::: The label is tracked separately from the auto-assigned ID: ::: {#a9c192f7 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} node.label ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 'A' ``` ::: ::: Any extra keyword arguments passed to `add_node()` are stored in `attributes`: ::: {#4d30b161 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} node.attributes ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` {'color': 'red', 'size': 10} ``` ::: :::
